name: enterprise-policies-eval-v1
description: Version-controlled evaluation set for the sample HR/IT policy corpus.

cases.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees accrue per year?
cases.expected_answer: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid vacation per year.

cases.question: What is the maximum vacation rollover?
cases.expected_answer: Unused vacation rolls over up to a maximum of 5 days.

cases.question: How much are meals reimbursed during business travel?
cases.expected_answer: Meals are reimbursed up to 50 dollars per day.

cases.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate?
cases.expected_answer: Mileage is reimbursed at 0.65 dollars per mile.

cases.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
cases.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with approval.

cases.question: Is multi-factor authentication required for remote work?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all systems.
